Practitioner: "The 'subfolders rank better' claim is anecdotal and comes from case studies with survivorship bias". Discourse: "Discourse already emits `DiscussionForumPosting` markup" and "`DISCOURSE_RELATIVE_URL_ROOT`... a recurring upgrade-pain point".
